name: manual_e2da55
claim: Never push directly to a canonical origin/main branch; treat it as operator-gated and route work through a feature branch and pull request

decisions.notes: Canonical main branches are branch-protected and require a human or designated-reviewer merge; a direct push fails auth and violates the merge freeze. Stale GH_TOKEN environment overrides also surface as HTTP 401 even when real credentials exist.

rationale: Canonical main branches are branch-protected and require a human or designated-reviewer merge; a direct push fails auth and violates the merge freeze. Stale GH_TOKEN environment overrides also surface as HTTP 401 even when real credentials exist.
